Spec corrections — calibration audit

Overall heightmeasuring… / spec 1,406.6
Front trackmeasuring… / spec 1,626.2
Rear trackmeasuring… / spec 1,614.3
Wheelbasemeasuring… / spec 2,735.0

Measured live from the corrected mesh, in millimetres. Runtime transforms only: each wheel assembly — tire (split into four per-wheel pieces), rim and brake disc — is tucked inboard 57 mm front / 65 mm rear so the tires sit flush with the fenders, and the body is stretched +6.25% in Z about the tire contact patch. Wheels, tires and brakes are never stretched, so the tires stay circular; overall length, body width and wheelbase are untouched, and the GLB file itself is not modified.
